content: Photoshop stroke smoothing (0-100%): Pulled String Mode (paint only when string past dead-zone circle), Stroke Catch-up (trails more when fast), Catch-up on Stroke End, Adjust for Zoom. Lazy Nezumi Pro: Pulled String (String Length), Moving Average (Catch Up on/off), Exponential Moving Average, Weighted preset = scripted physics with mass and drag, gravity-like effects, pressure derived from speed (maxPressureSpeed), pressure smoothing. Adobe help via search + lazynezumi.com fetch.
